ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 60% high-intensity white/cream pixels and 40% low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black pigmented region extending from the peduncle attachment to the median notch; distal lobes are primarily high-intensity white; dark pigmented banding follows the trailing edge and lobe tips; multiple small dark pixel clusters scattered within white fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; internal angle approximately 55 degrees; notch depth is approximately 15% of the total vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations across the entire trailing edge; right distal tip displays distinct high-amplitude jagged peaks (3-7 pixel amplitude); left lobe trailing edge shows smoother undulations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the outer lobe edges tapering to sharp, acute distal tips; moderate concavity observed on the inner lobe edges leading into the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct dark circular spot on the mid-outer left lobe; one dark ring-like circular anomaly on the distal right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, thin, vertically-oriented linear pixel disruptions present on the white ventral surface of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Evidence of multiple linear rake marks and circular scarring patterns distributed across both white ventral regions.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-tan chromatic staining (likely diatom bio-film) localized on the high-intensity white region of the left lobe.
